'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]], [[Bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***An [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] airstrike on a home in [[Beit Lahiya]] in [[North Gaza Governorate|North Gaza]] kills at least 15 [[Palestinians]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/6/26/israel-war-on-gaza-live-subhuman-conditions-in-camps-attacked-by-israel (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Bolivian coup attempt]]
**[[Bolivian President|President]] [[Luis Arce]] accuses [[Armed Forces of Bolivia|military]] general [[Juan José Zúñiga]] of plotting a [[coup]], and calls for a general strike and blocking of roads to prevent the coup. The attempted coup fails. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivias-president-slams-irregular-mobilization-army-units-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/bolivia-military-deployment-arce-coup-fears-028cd88f3be1fb02164c05deb0faa099 (AP)] 
**[[Bolivia]]n general [[Juan José Zúñiga]] is arrested following his failed coup attempt. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivias-general-zuniga-arrested-coup-attempt-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Niger]]
**[[Niger]]'s [[ministry of defence]] announces three days of national mourning following yesterday's ambush of security forces near the village of Tassia in [[Tillabéri Region]], which killed at least 20 soldiers and a civilian and injured several others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/26/at-least-20-soldiers-one-civilian-killed-in-western-niger (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**Two [[South Africa]]n soldiers are killed and twenty others are injured in a mortar attack on a [[South African National Defence Force]] logistics base in [[Sake, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Sake]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.sabcnews.com/sabcnews/repatriation-preparations-for-sandf-soldiers-killed-in-drc-under-way/ (SABC News)]
*Unidentified attackers open fire on a [[Tunisia]]n [[Tunisian Armed Forces|military]] patrol near the [[Libya–Tunisia border|border with Libya]], killing a soldier, according to the [[Ministry of Defence (Tunisia)|Tunisian Ministry of Defence]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/north-africa/2024/06/26/gunmen-attack-tunisian-military-patrol-near-libya-border-soldier-killed (Al Arabiya)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three fishermen are found dead following heavy rainfall and winds that caused [[coastal flooding]] along [[New Zealand]]'s eastern coast. [https://www.1news.co.nz/2024/06/26/live-evacuations-state-of-emergencies-after-flooding-on-east-coast/ (1 News)]
*Twenty people are killed following two days of heavy rains in [[Nepal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/heavy-rains-nepal-kill-20-two-days-amid-landslides-lightning-strikes-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–European Union relations]], [[Belarus–European Union relations]]
**The leaders of [[Poland]], [[Lithuania]], [[Latvia]], and [[Estonia]] call on the [[European Union]] to construct a [[Euro|€]]2.5 billion (US$2.67 billion) defence line between them and [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] to secure the EU from military, economic, and migrant-related threats. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/poland-baltics-call-eu-defence-line-border-with-russia-belarus-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Dutch Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] is formally selected as the next [[NATO Secretary-General]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/26/world/nato-rutte-secretary-general-intl (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in Mali]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] convicts [[Mali]]an Islamist [[Al Hassan Ag Abdoul Aziz]] of [[Ansar Dine]] on charges of war crimes and crimes against humanity. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/icc-convicts-mali-islamist-timbuktu-atrocities-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Germany|German]] government ministers agree on legislation to expedite [[Deportation|deportation]] for individuals who post or "[[like button|like]]" [[social media]] content that celebrates or promotes [[Terrorism|terrorist]] acts. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-cabinet-backs-deportations-for-praise-of-terrorism/a-69480819?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf (DW)]
*Former [[President of Honduras|Honduran President]] [[Juan Orlando Hernández]] is sentenced to 45 years in prison and fined $8 million for [[drug trafficking]] and firearms offences in a U.S. federal court. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/26/americas/juan-orlando-hernandez-sentencing-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/honduras-ex-president-hernandez-faces-long-prison-term-after-us-drug-conviction-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New York]]
**Incumbent [[New York (state)|New York]] representative [[Jamaal Bowman]] loses a [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] primary challenge against [[George Latimer (New York politician)|George Latimer]] in the [[New York's 16th congressional district|16th district]], in what has become the most expensive House of Representatives primary in history by campaign spending. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz99x0w65dyo (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/06/25/nyregion/bowman-latimer-house-new-york.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Kenya Finance Bill protests]]
**[[President of Kenya|President]] [[William Ruto]] withdraws the controversial [[Kenya Finance Bill 2024]] following an [[2024 Parliament of Kenya assault|assault on the parliament]] that killed multiple people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/kenyas-ruto-rejects-tax-bill-returns-it-parliament-local-media-reports-2024-06-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Government of France|France's government]] orders the dissolution of several [[Far right in France|far-right]] and [[Islamic extremism|radical Muslim]] groups prior to the [[2024 French legislative election|upcoming legislative election]] due to their violence, discrimination, and [[Hate speech laws in France|hate speech]] toward different races, women, and [[LGBT|LGBTQ+ people]]. [https://apnews.com/article/france-election-extremist-groups-banned-right-islamic-56eb2bffed27dc2a7c49beb40a70b553 (AP)]
